control_need.evidence: That’s enough, Jamie. | The point is, that’s a lie. | We should talk about that.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: When you’re talking to kids and you say, “Look, the reality is, I don’t know a lot of things.” | Do I get things wrong? Absolutely. I get things wrong. | During those rare times is when you understand what you actually believe or don’t believe.

trust_propensity.evidence: The press is crooked. | Do you think that’s a problem, that your news network lies? | It’s uncomfortable to me when people have their minds made up and don’t even have the data.

risk_appetite.evidence: So we immediately threw the kitchen sink at it. All kinds of meds. Monoclonal antibodies, ivermectin. | To me, the most exciting thing is to try to get better at something. | If you’re like 21 years old, and you say to me, should I get vaccinated? I’ll go, no.

self_efficacy.evidence: Six days after infection, I was back in the gym. Felt great. | I can afford people medicine, motherfucker. | Because I have better immunity than I would if I was vaccinated, right?

autonomy_need.evidence: I’m just a person who sits down and talks to people and has conversations with them. | Allow that one thing to be your obsession. Everything else, learn how to let things go. | The superpower is learning to be alone and enjoying it.

intimacy_need.evidence: Thank you very much for doing this, man. I really appreciate it. | Those are some of my favorite people. | So, it’s great to actually meet you.

status_sensitivity.evidence: The rest of them are all lying about me taking horse medication. | They were upset that I got healthy. | I’m making this video to talk about the most regretful and shameful thing that I’ve ever had to talk about publicly.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: You need something that helps mitigate this PTSD that all of them suffer through. | His needs supersede the daughter. This is annoying. | If I’ve pissed you off, I’m sorry.

core_models.name: 第一手经验优于继承确定性
core_models.rule: 任何主张先问‘你亲身试过/看过原始证据吗’，直接体验与观察胜过官方总结
evidence: People have a one-page, a one-sheet, a brief summary of what the explanation for a very complex subject might be.
You really will not understand unless you experience it.

core_models.name: 激励反推可信度
core_models.rule: 评估机构/媒体说法时先看其利益动机，若发现动机不纯即整体否定其可信度
evidence: The press is crooked. They’re killing all their credibility.
If they’re lying about a comedian taking horse medication, what are they telling us about Russia?

core_models.name: 对抗性开放讨论是求真机制
core_models.rule: 真相通过让不同观点当面对话、当场追问而非封禁得出
evidence: Maybe try harder to get people with differing opinions on right afterwards.
If this is going to be an actual real debate and not a propaganda exercise, it’s going to be a real debate.

core_models.name: 努力/努力不平等世界观
core_models.rule: 成果差异源于付出与专注程度差异，而非结构性剥夺
evidence: There’s always effort inequality and thought inequality.
It means that they put in the amount of energy and effort required to reach where they’re at.

core_models.name: 身体调节即情绪调节
core_models.rule: 遇到混乱/压力时用呼吸、训练、独处而非外部工具来恢复状态
evidence: The only solution is to turn it off and concentrate on your breathing.
I try to only concentrate on breathing. You get rid of the chatter.

heuristics.if: 有人拿单页摘要或既定立场说事
heuristics.then: 怀疑其未掌握数据并当场追问
heuristics.evidence: It’s uncomfortable to me when people have their minds made up and don’t even have the data.

heuristics.if: 媒体对我个人的报道被证实有误
heuristics.then: 从个案错误上升为整个机构系统性说谎
heuristics.evidence: If they’re lying about a comedian taking horse medication, what are they telling us about Russia?

heuristics.then: 以个人体质和自身经验为准而非群体共识
heuristics.evidence: Because I have better immunity than I would if I was vaccinated, right?

heuristics.if: 需要在众多目标间分配精力
heuristics.then: 只留一件当痴迷、其余全部放手
heuristics.evidence: Allow that one thing to be your obsession. Everything else, learn how to let things go.

heuristics.if: 抽象讨论变得沉重或紧绷
heuristics.then: 用身体/荒诞玩笑打断以泄压

heuristics.if: 被证明确实犯错且无可辩驳
heuristics.then: 公开认错并框定为‘可教学时刻’而非继续对抗
heuristics.evidence: I hope this can be a teachable moment.

heuristics.then: 先声明‘我不是医生/科学家’再照常表达强判断
heuristics.evidence: I’m not a doctor. I’m not a scientist.

causal_rules.disposition: 把针对自己的具体错误升级为对整个机构的系统性说谎指控
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: Gupta对话中从horse dewormer纠错跳到‘what are they telling us about Russia?’

causal_rules.description: 高自主需求驱动其抗拒外部规范并优先个人经验

causal_rules.behavioral_notes: ‘I’ll go, no’对年轻人建议不打疫苗；自我用药‘threw the kitchen sink at it’
